tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: borrower intimates intention not to renew the facility before the period as stipulated in the loan agreement, and the facility gets closed on the due date
tuples.quote: (6) In case of cash credit / overdraft facilities, no pre-payment charges shall be applicable if the borrower intimates a UCB of her / his / its intention not to renew the facility before the period as stipulated in the loan agreement, provided that the facility gets closed on the due date.
